summary.text: Catherine Ingram is a Democratic state senator from Ohio who has represented District 9 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She previously served in the Ohio House from 2017 to 2022 and on the Cincinnati School Board.

paragraphs.text: Catherine Ingram was born in and lives in Ohio and graduated from Woodward High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree and an M.B.A. from the University of Cincinnati.
Her career experience includes work in business, nonprofits, real estate, education and community services.
She served on the Cincinnati School Board and on the boards of the United Way of Greater Cincinnati, the Great Rivers Girl Scout Council and the Greater Cincinnati Black Achiever Award program.
Ingram represented District 32 in the Ohio House of Representatives from 2017 to 2022, serving as ranking member of the Higher Education and Career Readiness Committee in 2021–2022.
She took office in the Ohio Senate on January 1, 2023, succeeding Cecil Thomas.
In 2023–2024 her Senate committees included Primary and Secondary Education, Health, Insurance, and Workforce and Higher Education.
She advanced from the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Linda Matthews in the general election.
